target_customer: Teams that work in Slack (and later Microsoft Teams) and want an AI agent with company context to answer questions and do tasks
problem: Company knowledge is scattered and wikis go stale, and employees spend time on repetitive requests that an agent with full context could handle inside the chat tool they already use.
business_model: SaaS subscription for a model-agnostic Slack agent with integrations; pricing details not confirmed
product_category: AI coworker agent in Slack, enterprise knowledge and workflow automation

founders.name: Wilson Nguyen
founders.role: Founder, described as chief engineer in the launch post

competitors.name: Claude Tag (Anthropic)
competitors.what: Managed always-on AI teammate inside Slack for Enterprise and Team customers
competitors.traction_then: Launched June 23, 2026; adoption figures not found

competitors.name: Slackbot (Salesforce)
competitors.what: Native Slack assistant overhauled in early 2026

competitors.name: Glean
competitors.what: Enterprise search and agents across Slack, docs and tickets

technical_complexity.rationale: Model routing, 50 plus integrations, permissions and approval flows are standard engineering with some hard parts, built on third party models.

defensibility.rationale: Many similar Slack agents exist and Anthropic shipped Claude Tag weeks earlier; model agnosticism and the self-updating wiki are modest differentiators.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Anthropic launched Claude Tag in June 2026, shortly before the batch; the outcome for OpenTag is not yet known.

market_need_then: Companies were adopting AI agents in chat tools in 2026, and the launch of Claude Tag and roundups of alternatives show active demand for Slack-native agents.

identity.logo: A mark file named ot-mark; design not described in sources
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and practical, short plain claims about security and permissions

branding.brand_signature: Positioned as the model agnostic Claude Tag
branding.community_and_virality: Launched on Product Hunt on 2026-08-28 and reached roughly the top 5 or 6 of the day according to aggregators; a separate open source project called OpenTag from CopilotKit exists and may be a different entity.

brand_strength.rationale: Early brand with a Product Hunt launch, but the name collides with an unrelated or related open source OpenTag and the .com is a prefixed domain.

outcome_analysis: OpenTag is an Active company from the Summer 2026 batch, too early for an outcome. It enters a crowded space weeks after Anthropic launched Claude Tag, so its edge rests on being model agnostic and on team execution, and the founders have shipped a prior YC company together. No acquisition, shutdown or layoff news was found.
notes: Dealroom lists a 125k USD seed from a single aggregator snippet with investors paywalled; unverified, so not recorded as a round. The company site lists the legal entity as Open Curiosity, Inc. A CopilotKit open source project is also named OpenTag; relationship unclear. Aggregators disagree on founders; the YC page was used.
